definitions.explanation: For something to cease to exist or to no longer be present.

definitions.gloss: to run out, to be used up
definitions.explanation: For a supply of something to be exhausted or depleted.
A polite way to say someone has died (often written as 亡くなる with a different kanji).

examples.japanese: お{金|かね}が{無|な}くなってしまった。
{痛|いた}みが{無|な}くなりました。
{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}が{無|な}くなったので、{買|か}いに{行|い}きます。
examples.english: The milk has run out, so I'll go buy some.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {無|な}くす (transitive). Pattern: Xが{無|な}くなる (X disappears/runs out).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {無|な}くなっている = 'is gone/has run out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・お{金|かね}が{無|な}くなる (money runs out)
・{痛|いた}みが{無|な}くなる (pain goes away)
・{無|な}くなってしまった (it's all gone)
・{亡|な}くなる (pass away - different kanji)

PAIR: {無|な}くす (transitive) - {財布|さいふ}を{無|な}くした (lost wallet). {亡|な}くなる is polite 'pass away'.
